Thanks everyone for the call this morning. Notes and actions below (short version). Ive uploaded the initial evidence matrix and a condensed meeting note PDF to the shared Drive (link below) and attached a PDF export. Also included: a stub recording link (meeting_recording_link.txt).

Meeting notes — intake highlights:
- Scope: SummitEdge indicated they need coverage for EU and US production clusters (multi-region routing).
- Evidence requested during call: token auth logs (redacted), admin audit trail, retention policy docs, CAIQ answers annotated.
- Timeline: customers SOC 2 audit kickoff expected in Q2 2027; they requested an evidence package by end of March 2027 for initial review.

Action items (owner — due):
1) Marcus Lin — gather token issuance and admin audit samples (redacted) for last 30 days; upload to Drive (due 2026-12-10).
2) Kimberly Park — export retention policy + TTL config examples and flag any controls that require product changes (due 2026-12-13).
3) Irene Choi — annotate CAIQ workbook for high-priority questions and produce a short mapping doc for EU routing (due 2026-12-13).
4) Sam / SummitEdge — confirm which systems require sample logs (admin console vs ingestion API) and whether redaction is acceptable (due 2026-12-08).

Attachments uploaded: redwood_evidence_matrix_v2.pdf (initial mapping), summitedge_caiq_v1.xlsx (annotated copy), meeting_recording_link.txt

Temporary artifact hosting: Yes — we can provide a short-lived S3/secure link. I will coordinate with Security Ops to provision download links once artifacts are uploaded.

Next meeting: tentative follow-up 2026-12-15 to review the evidence package; will confirm after owners upload artifacts.

Thanks — feel free to flag any missing items.

Best,
